description: Get a short completion from a capable model, paid per call, with a bounded output of 2000 tokens. LLM inference pay-per-call, no account, no API key: prompt in, completion out (DeepSeek v4, up to 2000 output tokens). STANDARD tier; /v1/llm/pro is the PRO tier with four times the output budget. Original note on $/call on x402. Body: {prompt, system?, max_tokens?} — $0.010000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "complete this prompt", "short completion from a model", "cheap llm call".
name: llm
